templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Standard terms covering a provider's use of AI in its services, including use of customer data for model training and ownership of AI inputs and outputs. Added on top of an existing agreement.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement governing how a business associate may use, disclose and safeguard a covered entity's protected health information.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for selling and buying SaaS / cloud software, covering access and use, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability and termination.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for early-stage product collaboration where a design partner gets early access to a product in exchange for feedback.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Data Processing Agreement setting out how a provider processes customer personal data, including subprocessors, restricted (cross-border) transfers, security incident response, audits and deletion.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Standard Terms
templates.description: Standard terms of a mutual NDA under which both parties protect each other's confidential information. Incorporated by reference from the MNDA cover page.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
templates.description: Fill-in cover page for the mutual NDA capturing purpose, effective date, term, confidentiality period, governing law, modifications and signatures.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for business partnerships between companies, covering cooperation obligations, payments, trademark licensing, escalation procedures and liability.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Terms for a limited-time trial or pilot of a product before a customer commits to a full purchase.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services and deliver work product under statements of work.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service Level Agreement defining uptime and support response commitments for a cloud service, along with service credits when targets are missed.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing on-premise or self-hosted software, covering license scope, restrictions, fees, warranties and liability.
